remarks: Imagine beginning your morning with natural light filtering through floor-to-ceiling windows, enjoying coffee on your private terrace, and ending the evening entertaining friends on your rooftop deck. Welcome to Penthouse Residence 504 at 425 Palm, a boutique luxury address in Beverly Hills where generous proportions, thoughtful design, and indoor-outdoor living come together. With 2,221 square feet of interior living space, 11-foot ceilings, and expansive windows, this one-bedroom, one-and-a-half-bath residence offers a wonderful sense of openness.
